Name: Raincheck
Tasting_Notes: Citrus and sweet lime sneak in like a memory.
Desc:
Heavy-bodied and emotionally available. Caramel wraps you like an old jumper. Citrus and sweet lime sneak in like a memory. And that chocolate? It lingers like a song you didn’t know you missed. This one doesn't just brew - it   drips  . You’ll want to cancel your plans and call it nostalgia.  
   
   ROAST LEVEL:  Medium Plus    
   PROCESSING:  Washed + Naturals&nbsp;  
   REGION:   Venkids Valley Estate(Karnataka) &  Harley Estate(Karnataka)  
   ALTITUDE:  1200 MASL (metres above sea level)    
   VARIETAL:  SLN 9 + SLN 795     
   HARVEST:  2025    
   BEST BREW METHOD:  Expresso & Manual (Espresso, Moka Pot, South Indian Filter, Aeropress, French Press)    
   BEVERAGE STYLE:  Cold Brew, Manual Brews, Milk Based Drinks  
   
  Where Raincheck Grows  
    Raincheck   is grown where rain isn't a disruption, it's a rhythm. Two estates, two approaches, one shared respect for water, weather, and waiting for the right moment.  
  At   Venkids Valley Estate  , in the lush hills near Madikeri, nature sets the pace. This 200-acre expanse hums with wild fig, mango, avocado, and soapnut trees. Birds nest, breezes carry song, and coffee grows slowly beneath a dense canopy at 3600 feet. Pavan and Shilpa run the estate with quiet conviction, solar-powered homes, rainwater harvesting, and a community that’s been part of the land for decades. Here, modern machinery meets old-school care, and every bean reflects the patience of a place that listens to the rain.  
  Then there’s   Harley Estate  , further south in Sakleshpur. One of Karnataka’s most storied coffee farms, it balances heritage with innovation. With misty mornings and rich soil, Harley produces washed and natural coffees, and is known for its pioneering work in monsoon processing. Water isn’t just weather here, it’s part of the profile. Beans are aged in precisely controlled conditions, echoing the old shipping-route serendipity of monsooned coffee, but crafted with intention.  
  Together, these estates deliver a cup that’s moody, mellow, and quietly complex.   Raincheck   is for slow sippers and everything worth waiting for.

Name: Troublemaker
Tasting_Notes: Apricot and dark caramel pull you in, but it’s that figgy depth and nutty thump that makes you stay.
Desc:
This one? It doesn't ask for permission. Think sweet lime with a side of defiance. Apricot and dark caramel pull you in, but it’s that figgy depth and nutty thump that makes you stay. With milk or straight-up bold - it doesn’t care. It’s for the ones who rewrite the rules while sipping their second cup.  
  ROAST LEVEL : Medium 
   PROCESSING:  Washed + Naturals 
  REGION:   Venkids Valley Estate (Karnataka) &  The Laks Farm (Tamil Nadu) 
  ALTITUDE:  1300 MASL (metres above sea level) 
  VARIETAL:  Chandragiri + SLN 9 + Canephora 
  HARVEST:  2025 
  BEST BREW METHOD:  Expresso & Manual (French Press, Aeropress, Pour-over, South Indian Filter, Cold Brew) 
  BEVERAGE STYLE:  Cold Brew, Manual Brew, Milk Based Drinks  
  Where The Trouble Brews  
 Troublemaker isn’t born in one place. It comes from two farms, two philosophies, and one shared spirit: do things differently, and do them with intent. 
 First, there’s Venkids Valley Estate, tucked away in the Western Ghats near Madikeri. A winding road leads you in, past rivulets and wild fig trees, into 200 acres of untamed green. Pavan and Shilpa run the show, welcoming, passionate, and quietly rebellious. Here, at 3600 feet, coffee grows under a dense jungle canopy alongside over 40 species of trees. It’s processed with precision, but powered by people, a close-knit team living in solar-powered homes, harvesting rainwater, and keeping the land alive with every step. 
 Then, high in the Pulney Hills of Tamil Nadu, there’s The Laks Farm, nestled in Pachalur village. One of the highest coffee-growing regions in India, it runs on organic principles and deep respect for the ecosystem. No chemicals. No shortcuts. Just a farm where coffee grows with oranges, bananas, cardamom, and pepper, layered in flavor and full of life. 
 Together, these farms bring you a coffee that’s bold, bright, and a little wild. Just like its name. Troublemaker doesn’t play safe. It plays real.

Location – Garo Hills, Meghalaya    Altitude – 850 - 965 Masl    Varietal – Cauvery, SLN 795    Process – Anaerobic Naturals    Cup Notes – Java Plum, Black Raisin, Maple Syrup    Roast Profile – Light - Medium     Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz  
 Garo Sankalp A2-10 represents the evolving journey of  Project Sankalp , an initiative driven by  Waribok Daribok  to push cup quality through structured processing and farmer collaboration. Name: Halli Berri by Kambihalli Estate
Tasting_Notes: Location - Baba Budan Giri, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Altitude – 1200 Masl Varietal – Chandragiri Process – Honey Cup Notes – Lemon Black Tea, Areca Roast Profile – Light - Medium Net wt.
Desc:
Honey processed Chandragiri grown at 1200 MASL in the Bababudan Giri hills of Chikmagalur. Cultivated at   Kambihalli Estate   under shade-grown trees. This coffee reflects a deep connection to land and ecosystem. Expect   lemon black tea notes, mellow sweetness,   and a smooth, well-structured finish.   Kambihalli Estate traces its roots to the Kariappa family’s first land in Kambi‑Halli, or Iron Village. Passed through generations and now led by the women of the family, the estate continues a legacy shaped by care for both people and land. Since 1948, it has cultivated shade‑grown, sustainable specialty coffee in the Bababudan Giri range of the Western Ghats. Pepper, areca, and fruit trees grow alongside the coffee, nurturing biodiversity in a UNESCO‑recognised hotspot. The estate is proudly Rainforest Alliance Certified.

  Altitude – 1200 Masl  
  Varietal – Chandragiri

  Roast Profile – Light - Medium   Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz

  Medium Roast, freshly roasted, Speciality Blend Wine Barrel Aged with Sweet, Soft Spice and Cocoa flavours  
  Notes: Heady aroma with sweet nuances of fine malt and grapes  
  Processing: Washed  
  Altitude: 3000 ft  
  Origin: Chikmagalur  
 
 
 
 
 
  Our Latest Barrel-Aged Coffees are an experimental lot of specialty coffee beans from the highest peaks of Chikmagalur aged to perfection in the finest French Wine Cask Barrels. The resultant coffee is a cup that has a heady aroma complementing the sweet nuances of fine malt and grapes. We recommend a paper-based Aeropress or Pour Over brew method to really bring out the crisp inherent notes of this treasure!  
   Barrel-aged coffee is the process of rolling coffee beans in an aged barrel once used for aging wine or whiskey. This rolling process allows the beans to soak in the flavor and aromas of the barrel. The coffee beans are then roasted. This process gives the coffee flavour notes soaked up from the barrels

Name: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe Grade 1 Idido
Tasting_Notes: Grown at high elevations in the Gedeo Zone and washed for clarity, this coffee delivers delicate jasmine, bergamot, and lemon zest notes with a silky tea-like body and crisp acidity.
Desc:
Yirgacheffe Grade 1 Idido Ethiopian Specialty Arabica Coffee Beans 250g  
 
 
   
  Ethiopian Yirgacheffe Grade   1 – Idido  is a floral masterpiece. Grown at high elevations in the Gedeo Zone and washed for clarity, this coffee delivers delicate jasmine, bergamot, and lemon zest notes with a silky tea-like body and crisp acidity. Best brewed as a pour-over or Chemex, it's a favorite for black coffee lovers seeking refined and elegant cups. 
 
 
  Region:   Yirgacheffe, Gedeo Zone, Ethiopia 
 
 
  Elevation:   ~ 1,900–2,100 masl 
 
 
  Processing:   Washed (Grade 1) 
 
 
  Varietals:   Heirloom Ethiopian landraces 
 
 
   Roast Recommendation :  Light to Light-Medium 
 
 
  Cup Style: Delicate, floral, and tea-like  – a clean, elegant cup with bright citrus-laced acidity, silky mouthfeel, and lingering floral aftertaste. This is a quintessential washed Ethiopian profile:  refined, layered, and complex , ideal for slow sips and aroma appreciation.

Name: Ground Coffee - Decaf - Boothangudi Estate Decaffeinated - Pack of 250g
Tasting_Notes: Milk Chocolate, Mild Acidity, Balanced Body: Medium
Desc:
Boothangudi Estate | Decaffeinated Coffee | High Altitude Arabica  
  An Experimental Coffee Producer in Chikmagalur, India. This estate is Classified as a "Sacred Grove" that has a special religious and cultural importance. 
 Boothangudi Estate is located at an altitude of 1000-1000 MASL and has a  Perennial water source in the estate feeding the plantation, and as drinking water for the farmers.   
   Boothangudi is named after Lord Boothappan.   A powerful deity in the estate who is meant to protect the estate from natural calamities and keeps the people safe.   Lord Boothappan also ensures timely rains, brings birds, animals and insects to play various roles in balanced flora and fauna.    "Boothan" meaning Lord boothappan & "Gudi" meaning Temple.    Boothangudi is classified as "Sacred Groves" in india dating backing to over 2000 years old.   Every year, people from as far as 900+ kms travel to this place and offer gifts to god and pray for safety and prosperity.  
  This experimental plantation also processes it's high altitude arabicas with a  Honey process which is the most labor intensive, but worth an experiment! The natural stream, perennial water source is very essential for the estate apart from timely rains. It is used for pulping, washing and irrigation purposes. The coffee also undergoes hand garbling to remove twigs, leaves and unripe fruits before the pulping process. Just another highlight of the estate is the Areca Palms providing shades to these juicy arabica cherries year-round!   
   Natural CO2 Decaffeination :   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Decaffeination is the act of removing caffeine from coffee beans leaving the aroma as it is. It   is carried out while the beans are still ‘green’, before they are roasted  . Drinking decaffeinated coffee is in theory, a way of enjoying the beverage while eliminating the caffeine and preserving the taste.   
 
 
 
 
  Consumer preference for natural, organic, and minimally processed foods is growing dramatically, as we all recognise that a healthy lifestyle includes not only good exercise and nutrition but also the elimination of chemicals and artificial ingredients in our food. We are using Super Critical Co2 fluid extraction process for decaffeination of coffee.  
 
 
 
 
  Benefits of this method:  
 
 
 
 
  ·     Extracts Caffeine effectively. It’s a direct contact method but does not use chemicals  .   ·     Doesn't chemically affect proteins or carbohydrates of the coffee beans.   ·     The byproducts are natural and 100% recyclable.   ·     100% organic process.  
  ·     Green process.

 Varietal: 100% Arabica,  SLN. 795 
 Tasting Notes: Milk Chocolate, Mild Acidity, Balanced 
 Body: Medium 
 Altitude: 1000-1100M 
 Processing: Natural CO2 Decaffeination 
 Location:    Boothangudi,  Chikmagalur

 Baristas always recommend prewarming porcelain cups. That’s because a cold cup can reduce the temperature of freshly prepared coffee by as much as 10 degrees as soon as the beverage hits it. Ensuring that the cup is the right temperature is essential for helping the coffee aroma develop fully. 
 JURA’s practical, small cup warmer is the ideal partner to any automatic coffee machine. The cup warmer S keeps the cups inside it consistently at a temperature of around 55°C. The cover also prevents heat loss, saving energy as a result.

 The capacity of the cup warmer S is ideally suited to domestic use, providing space for eight espresso cups (diameter 57 mm), six coffee cups (diameter 66 mm) or four cappuccino cups (diameter 90 mm).  
 The perfect cup temperature 
 The cup warmer S keeps the cups inside it consistently at a temperature of around 55°C. The cover also prevents heat loss, saving energy. With cups prewarmed to the perfect temperature, your speciality coffees will be more aromatic than they’ve ever been – whether they’re a fiery espresso or a creamy cappuccino.

Name: Jura Z10 - Aluminium White - Fully Automatic Coffee Machine
Tasting_Notes: The end result is a natural, energizing and refreshing beverage in which the fruity aromas of the coffee can be fully enjoyed without being overwhelmed by bitters.
Desc:
Jura Z10 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Jura Z10, a Coffee Machine designed to perfection for the best coffee experience.  
 
 
 The groundbreaking Z10 with P.R.G. for hot and cold brew specialty coffees 
 
 A masterpiece of Swiss engineering, the new Z10 doubles the range of specialty coffees. At the touch of a button it prepares the full spectrum of hot drinks from intense espresso to on-trend flat white. It also opens up a whole new dimension in the enjoyment of coffee with the introduction of cold brew specialties. This is made possible thanks to the Product Recognizing Grinder (P.R.G.), which recognizes the chosen specialty and instantly and precisely adjusts the fineness of grind accordingly. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 In addition, JURA has developed the pioneering Cold Extraction Process – a quite literally refreshing top innovation. In this process, cold water is slowly pulsed through the freshly ground coffee under high pressure. The result is a completely new way of experiencing coffee – refreshing, energizing and with a wonderfully balanced aroma.  
 This outstanding premium coffee machine features a double-speed 4.3” touch display and the Blue Crystal Rotary Switch. Thanks to the Specialty Selection menu, it's exceptionally easy and intuitive to use. The technological quantum leap is also reflected in the sculptural design. The convex-concave front panel is visible proof of the attention to detail and absolute manufacturing precision. Its high quality makes the Z10 a statement of excellent taste. 
 
 
 
  Brand: Jura  
  Usage Type: Home & Offices  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The new Product Recognizing Grinder (P.R.G.) 
 To ensure the optimum grind for every specialty, JURA engineers developed the Product Recognizing Grinder (P.R.G.). The electronically controlled high-performance grinder adjusts in a fraction of a second to the predefined consistency of grind – much more quickly and frequently than could be done manually. Its spectrum ranges from very fine for short classics to very coarse for long specialties. But coffee lovers don’t need to worry, because the adjustment takes place automatically every time a beverage is prepared and, if preferred, can also be individually selected before each preparation with the Aroma Selection feature.  
 Cold brew – extreme freshness 
 Thanks to the Cold Extraction Process, the Z10 prepares genuine cold brew specialties. While many conventional cold coffee drinks consist mostly of hot-brewed coffee which is then chilled, in the Z10 extraction takes place with cold water, pulsed at high pressure, and more coarsely ground coffee. The end result is a natural, energizing and refreshing beverage in which the fruity aromas of the coffee can be fully enjoyed without being overwhelmed by bitters. Anything else would just be a cold coffee.  
 Eighth-generation brewing unit 
 The brewing unit is the most important part of any automatic coffee machine. For the Z10, JURA has created the eighth-generation brewing unit. With its unique 3D brewing technology, it allows the water to flow evenly through the ground coffee at multiple levels. This makes the most of the aroma, both in hot specialties and with cold brewing.   
 Lasting elegance 
 Design and the careful choice of materials play an important role in product durability. JURA always strives to achieve a design that people will be proud to own and that will still look fresh and modern after many years. Uncompromising quality, durable, high-quality materials and maximum engineering precision guarantee both culinary and aesthetic excellence throughout the lifetime of the machine.  A high-tech two-component method provides the surfaces with an intense sense of depth, so that just looking at the coffee machine is a pleasure in itself. The water tank with its elegant wave design and the harmonious filter casing are just two examples of the attention paid to what might seem like small details. As soon as you touch the Z10, you sense what true worth means to JURA.

Name: Whole Bean - Bettadamalali Estate - Pack of 250g
Tasting_Notes: Jaggery, Dark Chocolate, Honey, Citrus Finish Body: Medium - Heavy
Desc:
Bettadamalali Estate | 100% Shade Grown, High Altitude Arabica 
 Experience the exquisite taste of one-hundred percent shade-grown coffee, cultivated under a harmonious blend of both planted and native trees. The unique combination of shade and high altitude nurtures the coffee beans, resulting in a slower maturation process compared to beans grown in lower altitudes. This deliberate pace of growth yields a harmoniously balanced and flavourful cup of coffee that truly stands out 
 Nestled in the breathtaking hills and valleys of the Sahyadri range, also known as the Western Ghats, the coffee estate benefits from the richness of volcanic soil, pure water sources, invigoratingly crisp air, and meticulous care from the land's stewards. These factors converge to create coffee beans of unparalleled quality, setting Bettadamalali coffee apart as a beacon of excellence 
 The commitment to quality extends to the hand-picking of each individual coffee cherry at the estate. This hands-on approach ensures that only perfectly ripe, crimson-red cherries are selected, guaranteeing a pure and untainted coffee experience. By avoiding the inclusion of underripe or green cherries, this craft cup of coffee is free from any unwanted off-flavours that can result from using unripe beans 
 Bettadamalali coffee beans undergo a meticulous washing process. The cherries are first pulped, separating the pulp from the beans. Natural fermentation follows, after which the beans are meticulously washed with pristine water. The final step involves sun-drying the beans in Bettadamalali's dedicated drying yards 
 Experience the culmination of nature's perfection and human dedication in every sip of Bettadamalali coffee. Indulge in the richness of flavour that only truly exceptional coffee can deliver 
 
 Grade: Screen 16+  
 Varietal: 100% Arabica,  SLN. 795 
 Tasting Notes: Jaggery, Dark Chocolate, Honey, Citrus Finish  
 Body: Medium - Heavy 
 Altitude: 1100-1350M 
 Processing: Washed 
 Location:    Western Ghats,  Chikmagalur

Desc:
Boothangudi Estate | Decaffeinated Coffee | High Altitude Arabica  
  An Experimental Coffee Producer in Chikmagalur, India. This estate is Classified as a "Sacred Grove" that has a special religious and cultural importance. 
 Boothangudi Estate is located at an altitude of 1000-1000 MASL and has a  Perennial water source in the estate feeding the plantation, and as drinking water for the farmers.   
   Boothangudi is named after Lord Boothappan.   A powerful deity in the estate who is meant to protect the estate from natural calamities and keeps the people safe.   Lord Boothappan also ensures timely rains, brings birds, animals and insects to play various roles in balanced flora and fauna.    "Boothan" meaning Lord boothappan & "Gudi" meaning Temple.    Boothangudi is classified as "Sacred Groves" in india dating backing to over 2000 years old.   Every year, people from as far as 900+ kms travel to this place and offer gifts to god and pray for safety and prosperity.  
  This experimental plantation also processes it's high altitude arabicas with a  Honey process which is the most labor intensive, but worth an experiment! The natural stream, perennial water source is very essential for the estate apart from timely rains. It is used for pulping, washing and irrigation purposes.   Decaffeination is the act of removing caffeine from coffee beans leaving the aroma as it is. It   is carried out while the beans are still ‘green’, before they are roasted  . Drinking decaffeinated coffee is in theory, a way of enjoying the beverage while eliminating the caffeine and preserving the taste.   
 
 
 
 
  Consumer preference for natural, organic, and minimally processed foods is growing dramatically, as we all recognise that a healthy lifestyle includes not only good exercise and nutrition but also the elimination of chemicals and artificial ingredients in our food. We are using Super Critical Co2 fluid extraction process for decaffeination of coffee.

 A 20 km drive from the scenic Madikeri town of the Coorg district in Karnataka leads you to the sprawling Ponnathmotte Estate, where the rich aroma of coffee beans engulfs you. The word ‘Ponnathmotte’ means ‘Golden Hills’ in the local language. The estate was started over 80 years ago and is now looked after by the owners’ third generation. The region is blessed with adequate rainfall, rich soil, and an ideal climate suited to growing coffee. 
 Thanks to its elevation of 3,600 ft. (1,100 m), Ponnathmotte Estate produces superior quality of Robusta & Arabica coffee seeds, as well as a special blend of hybrid variety known as CxR(Coffea congenisis and Robusta) . The estate’s immense tree canopy attracts a wide variety of migratory birds from long distances and provides a natural habitat for insects and honeybees. These factors help in better cross-pollination thus increasing the yield of Robusta. Also, thanks to the natural farming techniques employed, the coffee beans produced meet the highest quality standards. 
 Another specialty is the good number of rosewood trees that thrive in the estate and provide filter shade which is necessary for coffee plants. Cluster fig trees can be seen as well around the plantation, which not only provide shade, but its fruit cultivation is known to improve the coffee taste. Ponnathmotte Estate employs a full-time labour force who are provided individual quarters within the estate. The estate also grows other spices such as cardamom, pepper, and a few selections of fruits.

Name: Dēvagāndhāri
Tasting_Notes: This year's lot is also floral (albeit with less intensity than last year's lot) but is doubly as juicy and sweet with the acidity reminding us of Orange pulp and the sweetness of raisins.
Desc:
Last year's floral hit is back!   Situated in Chikmagalur, Indravathi estate is the second fully organic farm we have sourced from. It is managed by the same folks who run Narmada estate and boy does the care show in the cup! 
  For this lot, cherries have been picked ripe, pulped (i.e the skin being removed) and then dried carefully on raised beds along with the mucilage. The end result of this process is very enjoyable! 
  This year's lot is also floral (albeit with less  intensity than last year's lot) but is doubly as juicy  and sweet with the acidity reminding us of Orange pulp and the sweetness of raisins. 
  This coffee from Indravathi estate reminds us of the coffee dēvagāndhāri(think of it as ārabhi 's pulpier cousin, musically speaking).  
 Dēvagāndhāri the coffee is an absolute delight across all manual brews but shines the most in a no bypass brewer (we use the tricolate), 6 days post roasting. It also makes a pulpy shot of espresso 12 days post date of roast. 
  We thank South India Coffee Company for having helping us procure this hidden gem for a second straight year!

Last year's floral hit is back!   Situated in Chikmagalur, Indravathi estate is the second fully organic farm we have sourced from. It is managed by the same folks who run Narmada estate and boy does the care show in the cup! 
  For this lot, cherries have been picked ripe, pulped (i.e the skin being removed) and then dried carefully on raised beds along with the mucilage. The end result of this process is very enjoyable! 
  This year's lot is also floral (albeit with less  intensity than last year's lot) but is doubly as juicy  and sweet with the acidity reminding us of Orange pulp and the sweetness of raisins. 
  This coffee from Indravathi estate reminds us of the coffee dēvagāndhāri(think of it as ārabhi 's pulpier cousin, musically speaking).  
 Dēvagāndhāri the coffee is an absolute delight across all manual brews but shines the most in a no bypass brewer (we use the tricolate), 6 days post roasting. It also makes a pulpy shot of espresso 12 days post date of roast. 
  We thank South India Coffee Company for having helping us procure this hidden gem for a second straight year!

Name: Hamīrkalyāni
Tasting_Notes: The resulting cup is very sweet and rather interesting; bursting with cardamom like spice notes .
Desc:
We have a new honey process coffee and it's extra sweet! 
 Sourced from Krishnagiri estate ,high up in the Chandra drona hills(a.k.a the Giris) of Chikmagalur, this particular lot fascinated us with its sweetness and lingering fruitiness. 
 Ripe cherries of the SLn. 795varietal have been selected and fermented in 2 stages for 72hours. The coffee is then pulped and slow dried for 10-12 days. 
 The resulting cup is very sweet and rather interesting;  bursting with cardamom like spice notes . The lychee like tartness reminds us of the rāga Hamīrkalyāni and this coffee is very drinkable( we kept sipping a lot of it during testing). Hamīrkalyāni the coffee, is a delight across all manual brews 8 days from date of roast  and also makes for a partly sweet ,partly fruity  shot of espresso 16 days from date of roast.

Name: Mind=blown (redux)
Tasting_Notes: We taste very prominent peach and green grapes in the acidity that is balanced really well with a vanilla-eque sweetness.
Desc:
OG best seller is back again and this time it's a light roast! We always ask the good folks at Mooleh Manay for more coffee when we run out of mind=blown. This season, they obliged! 
  This is the same coffee as what was launched earlier, so the processing details are the same . The good folks at Mooleh Manay wanted  to up the complexity of this year's lot while maintaining the consistency they achieved last year. To do this, they decided to throw the kitchen sink at the coffee in the processing department by using a custom yeast  culture along with carbonic maceration. 
  The start of the intricate process is by picking ripe arabica cherries(mix of Sln6, Sln 9 and Chandragiri) and using a syphon tank to remove immature cherries that float. 
  The sunken cherries are then pre dried for 48 hours. This is a very important step as it reduces the moisture, which helps achieve better control in the fermentation. This goes a long way to prevent any off flavours. 
  The pre-dried cherries are then put in sealed barrels along with a custom yeast culture and a controlled carbonic maceration enviornment is created. The fermentation lasts for 60 hours. 
  The cherries are then dried in a poly house for 10 days, where they are raked constantly to ensure even drying. 
  This extensive and intricate process has resulted in a coffee that is a revelation! Since we were sent this bag a couple of months ago, we wanted to do something different to highlight what the coffee has to offer. After much experimentation we settled in on a light roast profile that minimises bitterness and maximises the acidity. We taste very prominent peach and green grapes  in the acidity that is balanced really well with a vanilla-eque sweetness. This coffee is a real  delight on a manual brew(we prefer a v60) with really vibrant  acidity, good sweetness and next to no bitterness even when extraction is pushed. 
  The coffee really opens up 12days post roast date for manual brews and makes for a fruit jam of an espresso 20 days post roast date. This coffee is not be missed on any count!

Tasting_Notes: blood orange and lychee with a lingering raisin like sweetness; reminding us of the rāga Nalinakānti Nalinakānti the coffee is a very sweet , complex, sippable brew and is a deligh
Desc:
We have a new coffee from Ram estate and it's a super complex honey!  
  Located in the village of Kamanur near Thandigudi, Ram estate (called Rothaikadu by locals ) posseses a unique microclimate that is idealfor growing complex arabicas  and the folks there  have been processing top notch coffees from year one of their foray into the  speciality scene. The estate has also gone spray-free, with organic inputs being applied directly above the root system instead of being sprayed, helping to reduce runoff. 
   This particular lot consists only of  selectively picked SLN 09 arabica from the estate's highest portion. The cherries were fermented in a sealed barrel for 120 hours. They were then pulped and slow dried in a well ventilated polyhouse. 
   The resulting cup is very aromatic ,very  citrusy  and very sweet, but also shockingly 'clean' tasting ; without any fermenty notes. This is party a result of the aforementioned microclimate and partly because of careful monitoring of the cherries during fermentation and the slow drying.  The acidity tastes of blood orange and lychee with a lingering raisin like sweetness; reminding us of the rāga Nalinakānti  
 Nalinakānti the coffee is a very sweet , complex, sippable brew  and is a delight across all manual brew methods 8 days post roasting. It makes a fruity shot of espresso 16 days post date of roast.

Name: Nātakurinji
Tasting_Notes: We taste a bengal currant like acidity , chocolatey sweetness(think of 50% cacao chocolates) and a mild booziness which is tied together with a very prominent rose like aroma.
Desc:
We super excited to be working with a new farm from the Kodaikanal area this year. Their coffee is quite the flavour bomb! 
  Ammikulavi estate is nestled in the upper reaches of the lower Kodaikanal hills and is possesses an ideal climate to grow arabica.  
  For this lot, ripe cherries of the largely caturra varietal( with some SLn 09 and SLN 795) were floated to select for density, sorted once more to select for ultra ripeness and then put in barrels to ferment for 72 hours. The fermentation was carefully monitored and the cherries were then slow-dried on raised beds over 10-14 days.  
  Such meticulous monitoring across all the steps have made this coffee a fruity delight with the intensity dialled upto 11! We taste a bengal currant like acidity , chocolatey sweetness(think of 50% cacao chocolates) and a mild booziness which is tied together with a very prominent rose like aroma. 
 The overt fruitiness reminded our roaster of the rāga Nātakurinji. Nātakurinji the coffee is a punchy delight across all manual brews 5 days post date of roast and makes for a part fruity part chcoclatey espresso 14 days post roast.

Name: Pūrnashadjam
Tasting_Notes: We taste a pleasant sweetness and nuttiness that reminds us of raisins and biscotti.
Desc:
After a lot of searching, we finally found a robusta we liked; and it's from our O.G. parter farm! 
  We have always wanted to feature robustas but never found one that blew our socks off, until now! 
  The good folks at Mooleh Manay have thrown the kitchen sink at processing their robusta with the aim of making it delightful in the cup and boy have they delivered! 
 For this lot, ripe C×R cherries are floated to remove defects and then fermented in sealed pressurised  barrels with a custom cluture for 120 hours. The combination of pressure from the CO2 and the custom culture ensures proper breakdown of the mucilage. The cherries are then slow dried on raised beds to stabilise  water activity. 
  The result of all this care is a cup that has none of the harshness that is usually associated with robusta. We have infact  roasted this coffee to medium as it would be a crime to mask the complexity with a darker roast!  
 All our test roasts were smooth, sweet and fruity! We taste a pleasant sweetness and nuttiness that reminds us of raisins and biscotti. The cherry like fruitiness present in the aroma shows up towards the end especially as the cup cools. We were stumped by how soft all test batches tasted! This is indeed a robusta revelation. The elegance of this coffee reminded us of the rāga pūrnashadjam (which is a slightly rare but has oodles of consonance). 
 Pūrnashadjam the coffee makes for a delightful manual brew (we prefer a 16.5 g dose for 300g water to deal with the extra caffeine) on a v60 7 days post roast and makes for a sweet sweet shot of Crema laden espresso 18 days from the date of roast.

Name: Baarbara Estate - Honey Sundried Processed
Tasting_Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness
Desc:
Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed Arabica   Single Origin | Medium Roast | Limited Estate Release  
 Nestled in the misty heights of the Western Ghats,  Baarbara Estate  is a third-generation coffee plantation run by the  Indavara family , proud cultivators of coffee since  1896  under  MG Plantations . With over 120 years of heritage and a deep-rooted commitment to sustainability, the estate is certified by both  UTZ  and the  Rainforest Alliance . 
 At elevations ranging from  3,850 to 5,350 feet , this estate produces exceptional  Selection 795 Arabica , shade-grown in rich biodiversity. The result is a coffee that truly reflects the unique terroir of  Chikmagalur , near the sacred foothills of  Bababudan Giri  India’s coffee cradle. 
 At Korebi Coffee, we collaborate closely with estates like Baarbara to  develop a roast that captures the estate’s unique character and natural expression . This year’s release is a  Honey Processed  lot, using a time-intensive and flavor-rich technique. 
 ☀️ About the Honey Sun-Dried Process: 
 In the  honey process , freshly pulped beans are  left with some of their sticky mucilage intact  and then  sun-dried on raised beds . This method named for the golden, honey-like texture of the drying beans enhances the coffee’s  natural sweetness and fruity depth , while preserving the  clarity and balance  of a washed coffee. It’s a labor of love that results in a cup with exceptional character. 
 ☕ Tasting Notes: 
 Expect a  bright, fruity aroma  with notes of  berries , a  rounded body , and a  lingering sweetness . The  medium roast  preserves the vibrant complexity of the honey process while delivering a smooth, balanced finish. 
  Key Features:  
 
 
  100% Arabica | Single Origin | Shade Grown  
 
 
  Honey Sun-Dried for Sweet, Fruit-Forward Notes  
 
 
  Ethically Sourced | UTZ & Rainforest Alliance Certified  
 
 
  Handpicked at High Elevation (3850–5350 ft)  
 
 
  Available as Whole Bean or Freshly Ground  
 
 
 Perfect for those who seek  sweet, nuanced, and expertly processed coffee ,  Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed  is a standout in our estate collection and a true expression of Indian specialty coffee done right.

Tasting_Notes: Bubble Bliss has a very sweet aroma and tastes almost like chocolate with a hint of raisins.
Desc:
Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a process called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this. This blend is made in micro batches and each batch is processed in a fully sealed vacuum chamber without the presence of any oxygen. It took us months of tweaking to perfect our process and we call the product Bubble Bliss. The name is a riff on the process, as it was processed in a bubble, as some would say! 
 Bubble Bliss has a very sweet aroma and tastes almost like chocolate with a hint of raisins. It brews a flavour balanced cup every time, this is for those who love consistency. 
 Bubble Bliss is made with 100% shade-grown, single origin, AAA Grade Arabica. Available as whole  beans or ground  for your choice of equipment. 
  Perfect for those who appreciate complex and balanced flavors, this blend is available in various grind options to suit your brewing method.

Name: Pineapple Express
Tasting_Notes: pineapple, it carries the spirit of tropical innovation in every sip
Desc:
Pineapple Express - 2025 Harvest  
  Pineapple Fermentation | Microlot Series  
 Welcome to the cutting edge of Indian specialty coffee.  Pineapple Express  is a bold and vibrant microlot crafted at  Barbara Estate , nestled in the highlands of  Baba Budangiri, Chikmagalur . Grown at an elevation of  1550m  and fermented using ripe pineapple, this coffee is the result of pioneering post-harvest innovation - an experiment in flavor that delivers a one-of-a-kind sensory experience. 
 This  medium roast  100% Arabica coffee opens with a  winey acidity  and  sweet dried fruit aroma , evolving into notes of  apple, dried mango, vanilla, and caramel , with a whisper of spice and a refined, spirit-like finish. It's the perfect harmony of brightness and sweetness - delightfully unexpected, yet beautifully balanced. 
 Whether you brew it as espresso, French press, moka pot, or cold brew,  Pineapple Express  is a journey worth taking.   Why Pineapple Fermentation?  The pineapple not only contributes natural sugars and microbial diversity to enhance fermentation, but it also accelerates mucilage breakdown, ensuring a cleaner drying process and a mold-free bean. The result is a coffee bursting with flavor, though it doesn’t taste like pineapple, it carries the  spirit of tropical innovation  in every sip.

Desc:
Blending Passion, Creativity, and Community—KIMERA  was born from real challenges faced by baristas, from handle misalignment to discomfort with single-spout, handleless pitchers. Designed to enhance comfort and control, KIMERA is a tri-spout, handleless tool crafted in collaboration with  Slow Pour Supply . Built by latte artists for latte artists, it’s made to inspire creativity and elevate the pouring experience.  
 SPOUT DESIGNS POWERED BY WPM 
 
 Drawing on years of expertise in spout shape design, our collaboration has resulted in the creation of a groundbreaking offering:    the high precision tapered spout #08 . This spout mirrors the finesse of a fine-tipped pen, making it ideal for intricate combination pours, particularly in a drag and draw style. This ergonomic design promotes a more relaxed and efficient pouring experience, ultimately enhancing the barista's workflow.

This ergonomic feature is crucial for reducing strain on the abductor muscles of the hand and wrist. By fitting ergonomically in the hand, the pitcher further enhances comfort during prolonged use, allowing baristas to maintain a natural and relaxed grip without excessive strain.  
  The combination of balanced weight distribution, enhanced control through the triangular arrangement of spouts, improved ergonomics with the 120-degree spacing, and a thoughtfully designed rim diameter collectively contribute to a superior pouring experience. Name: Madhu Agro Honey Sundried | Single Origin Microlot | Koraput | Medium Roast | 250 G
Desc:
100% ARABICA | HONEY SUNDRIED | MICROLOT | KORAPUT | 250 G

We have roasted with our signature recipe to accentuate sweetness and body..

  About Madhu Agro Honey Sundried Microlot Coffee:  
 Madhu Agro is a 100% women’s initiative in Koraput, Odisha led by mother and daughter duo of Nirmala Reddy & Raji Reddy. The farm truly integrates nature into it's fold to maintain bio-diversity. While honey bees play an important role in pollination, the farm provides a safe habitat for monkeys and many more animals.

Welcome to the Coffee Learning Community (CLC) Where Curiosity Meets Craft At CLC, we believe that coffee is more than just a beverage—it’s a bridge between people, cultures, and possibilities. Founded with the vision of nurturing a deeper understanding of coffee from seed to cup, the Coffee Learning Community is a space for growers, roasters, baristas, and enthusiasts to connect, share, and grow together. Whether you're just beginning your journey or seeking to deepen your craft, CLC offers hands-on experiences, expert-led workshops, and collaborative learning opportunities designed to inspire and empower. Rooted in sustainability, quality, and inclusivity, our community brings together passionate individuals who care deeply about the future of coffee. From soil health to sensory analysis, from fermentation techniques to roasting mastery, every session is crafted to expand knowledge and celebrate the people behind each bean. Come learn, taste, question, and create with us. Because great coffee starts with great learning.

Coffee Collection 2024–2026 A Journey in Every Cup Welcome to the 2024–2025 edition of our Coffee Collection. Our story began in 2008, in a small village near Pondicherry, with a simple dream: to roast exceptional Indian coffees, one small batch at a time. With little more than a passion for flavour and a vision for quality, the first roasts were crafted by hand—humble beginnings that sparked a journey of discovery, dedication, and craftsmanship. Seventeen years later, that same spirit continues to guide us. This year’s collection celebrates the full spectrum of coffee—from minty, full-bodied Vienna roasts to bright and delicate light-roasted single estates. Whether you're seeking a comforting breakfast blend, an intense espresso, or a rare micro-lot, each coffee is a reflection of our unwavering commitment to quality, traceability, and flavour. Every bean carries a story. In every roast a mindful act. May the coffee spirit be with you.

Name: 3 month subscription -Brewin'-a-cup : Parama
Tasting_Notes: chocolate and caramel with a creamy mouthfeel
Desc:
Order once and get the convenience of a subscription of our hugely popular Parama Brewin'-a-cup. Our favourite blend finds a new avatar with this easy-to-brew all in one pour-over filter. Parama is our luxury blend, with bold notes of chocolate and caramel with a creamy mouthfeel. Perfect if you like something bold and black or if are adding milk or any whitener.  
 All you need is a cup, to brew this luxury blend. Simply tear open the sachet, strap the filter on to your favourite cup, pour hot water and count the minutes until you can immerse yourself into some coffee goodness.

Name: Aeropress Coffee Maker
Desc:
Really simple to use, and easy to travel with, this home espresso (style) coffee maker gives you a very clean and flavourful shot of coffee. This is the ideal drink that can be enjoyed as is (like an espresso shot), or with hot water to make an Americano or black coffee, or a latte or cappuccino if you add milk. This comes with paper filters that help keep even the fine coffee grounds out of your cup.  
 The Paper filters are easily available whenever you run out.  
 You could use this Aeropress coffee maker to brew cold brew coffee too. Inverted Aeropress is also a brewing technique that you could explore for a bolder cup of coffee.

Name: Airscape Coffee Canister - coffee storage for freshness
Desc: Moisture and air are roasted coffee's biggest enemies! Keep your coffee fresh with this patented freshness-locking system. This canister, or coffee reusable container, comes with two lids. The inner lid can be pushed down towards the level of the coffee and then locked to create a vacuum that does not allow any air or moisture inside. As you keep using your coffee beans or powder the lid can be pushed further down so that there is hardly any gap between the coffee and the lid. How do you store coffee to keep it fresh? here is your answer.

Name: Arabica Tasters Set
Desc: 5 of our most popular single estate Arabica coffees. From our lightest roast (Say Hello To Mellow) to our darkest (Tall Dark Handsome), these arabicas are each a distinct bag of fabulousness. Perfect if you are setting out to choose your favourite amongst Maverick & Farmers arabicas or if you simply are looking for a different coffee each day of the week. Our Arabica Coffee Flight is a great gifting option too! Each pack contains 50 gms of freshly roasted Arabica. Choose your grind size (or whole beans if you wish) and we'll do the rest!

Name: Beginner stainless steel Moka Pot + Coffee pack
Desc:
Shipped with a 50gm pack of Moka-pot grind coffee. Choose your preferred coffee! 
 Extremely durable and built for rugged use, this functional stainless steel moka pot is a great way to start brewing espresso at home. Simple to use, it works efficiently   on your gas stove, brewing an espresso shot in under 4 minutes.  
 This little wondrous piece of brewing equipment brews home-espresso that's enough for 2 cups of coffee. 
 Freshly roasted coffee powder (preferably) that's ground medium fine (ask for our 'moka pot grind') is placed in the coffee filter basket. Water is filled upto the safety valve level in the lower chamber. The upper chamber is then screwed into place,  
 All it takes from here on is to place this on the fire, and a quick 2-4 minutes later you have freshly brewed espresso!

Name: Bialetti 3-cup moka pot - Italian edition
Desc:
The name that's synonymous with Moka Pots - Bialetti - brings you this original aluminium body (truly classic) with the limited edition Italian tricolour. A perfect home espresso coffee maker.  
 Perfectly crafted and designed, the moka pot has 3 parts - the coffee basket, the lower chamber (water reservoir) and the upper flip top chamber that collects the brewed espresso.  
 This moka pot makes 3 cups and comes with a fitted safety valve and a built-to-last gasket.

Name: Brewing on the X Bloom’s by Kaapi Machines
Desc:
xBloom Original – The Smartest Way to Brew Specialty Coffee 
 The xBloom Original is an advanced automatic coffee brewer that redefines home and office coffee experiences. Designed to replicate the precision of a barista’s pour-over technique, it seamlessly integrates grinding, dosing, and brewing into a single touchless process. Featuring RFID-enabled smart brewing, it recognizes pre-set coffee profiles and adjusts grind size, water flow, and temperature to match the coffee’s optimal extraction parameters. With its built-in burr grinder, the xBloom ensures freshly ground coffee for each cup. The gooseneck pour system mimics expert pouring motions, delivering even saturation and enhanced flavor. A minimalist touchscreen interface provides intuitive controls for effortless brewing. Ideal for coffee enthusiasts seeking precision, convenience, and café-quality results, the xBloom eliminates guesswork while preserving the craft of specialty coffee. Whether at home or in the office, it guarantees a flawless cup with every brew—all at the press of a button. 
 xBloom Studio KEY FEATURES: 
 1. Built-In Smart Grinder: Freshly grinds coffee beans to the perfect consistency for each brew. 2. RFID-Enabled Brewing Profiles: It auto-detects coffee parameters for precise, hands-free brewing. 3. Barista-Level Pour-Over Replication: Simulates expert pouring techniques for optimal flavor extraction. 4. Intuitive Touchscreen Controls: Simple user interface for seamless operation and customization. 5. Sleek & Minimalist Design: Modern aesthetic that complements any kitchen or workspace. 
  
 
 
   
 
  Where: Maverick & Farmer Coffee, Ulsoor!   
  When: 1st Mar 2026, 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM

Name: Cafe Chic
Desc: Cafe Chic is our only South-Indian styled chicory blend, and is a tribute to the beautiful South Indian tradition of coffee drinking. The chicory (for those of you unfamiliar with chicory, it is the root of the chicory plant, which when roasted creates a flavour and aroma that is very similar to coffee, yet has a very unique taste profile. Initially considered an ‘adulterant’ because of high coffee costs during the Second World War, in France, chicory is now added to coffee to give it that distinct and unique taste). Our Chicory blended South Indian coffee has also got the extra  boldness that comes with a higher amount of Peaberry beans. We source our chicory from a farmer from one of India’s finest chicory-growing regions.

Name: Clouds In My Coffee
Tasting_Notes: Earthy, Spice and nuts
Desc:
Clouds in My Coffee is a Monsooned Malabar coffee. Our single estate Arabica green coffee beans are kept in shipping containers by the coast for a few months. The moist sea air is absorbed by the beans and they bloat up and turn whitish. The taste profile of the coffee changes completely and makes for a really interesting specialty black coffee. Perfect for Americano or single-serve coffees such as pour-over / French press etc.   
 Bean: Arabica  
 Process: Washed, then Monsooned 
 Roast Profile: Medium light, quick roast. 
  Tasting notes: Earthy, Spice and nuts.

Name: Coffee & Cantonment - Gully Tour’s Coffee Chronicles featuring Maverick & Farmer
Desc:
Coffee Chronicles is a curated evening walk that explores Bangalore’s deep-rooted relationship with coffee alongside the layered history of the Cantonment. Beginning in collaboration with Maverick & Farmer, the experience connects heritage streets, evolving café culture, and the city’s social fabric, offering a sensory and cultural lens into how coffee became part of Bangalore’s identity. Designed for coffee enthusiasts and urban explorers, this trail blends history, culture, and flavor in a relaxed walking format. 
   Pick up point : Maverick & Farmer Coffee, Church Street!   
 
   Date: 28th Feb & 1st Mar, 4:30 PM onwards!

Name: Coffee brewing digital timer
Tasting_Notes: what brewing times work especially for you, and therefore creating recipes of your own
Desc:
All great home-brewed coffee starts with following recipes. And recipes include not just ingredients, but are also heavily dependent on time. 10 - 20 seconds past the recommended brewing time could lead to an over-extracted brew. 
 This simple to use coffee brewing digital timer not only helps you follow your tried and tested recipes, but also enables to make notes of what brewing times work especially for you, and therefore creating recipes of your own.  
 If you are using a French press, Pour over, Chemex, Clever dripper, Aeropress, and especially a Channi (strainer) to brew coffee, this handy device is perfect for you.

Name: Coffee grinder - Manual
Desc:
If you are a home-brewer and you enjoy your 1-4 cups cups of coffee a day, then this hand grinder is a must have. Made by Timemore, the brand that's winning prestigious Red Dot design awards for their coffee home-brewing products, this is great, durable quality at an affordable price. 
 There's nothing like grinding your coffee beans just a few minutes before you brew it, ensure amazing flavours and aromas. This manual grinder helps you do that, with grind sizes that range from espresso (fine ) to French press (coarse). Up your coffee gave, and complete your brewing equipment set with this grinder.

Name: Coffee Roasting Uncovered by Faiyaz and Sumit
Desc:
Step inside the roastery and experience coffee beyond the cup. This immersive session takes you through the complete journey of coffee—from origin to roast. Learn about coffee-growing regions, processing methods, and the key differences between Arabica and Robusta. Dive deeper into green coffee evaluation by understanding bean structure, density, moisture content, defects, grading, and ideal storage conditions.  
  The workshop then moves into the fundamentals of coffee roasting, breaking down each stage of the roast- drying phase, Maillard reaction, caramelization, first and second crack, and development time. Participants will also gain insight into roast profile control, including time-temperature balance, airflow management, and development percentage.  
  The session concludes with a   live roasting demonstration  , offering a practical look at how theory translates into flavor. Designed for curious beginners and coffee enthusiasts alike, this workshop is a hands-on introduction to the science and craft behind great coffee.  
  
 
 
   
 
  Where: Maverick & Farmer Coffee, Ulsoor!   
  When: 28th Feb 2026, 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM

Name: Cold brew - New Orleans Style
Tasting_Notes: Chocolate, Toffee
Desc:
Our New Orleans Style of cold brew is a blend of dark roasted  honey sun-dried coffee and roasted chicory root. This blend produces a strong, rich, deep and flavourful cold brew concentrate that tastes divine with a few ice cubes and some milk. Or condensed milk.   
 A quick history lesson? Thanks to the French influence in New Orleans, roasted chicory root added to roasted coffee became a thing among the locals. Initially meant to make coffee beans last longer thanks to the shortage caused during the war, this unique flavour in the brew developed a huge fan following well past the years of war.  
 Try this style of cold brew, especially if you like cold brew with milk or ice cream or cream or almond milk or condensed milk or.. ok, we're going to stop now.  
  Cold Brew - New Orleans Style is one of our 3 unique cold brew coffees for 2021. Check out the others  here . 
 Don't have a cold brew maker? Buy an easy to use, inexpensive one  here  
 Bean: Arabica, Robusta 
 Roasted Chicory root 
 Process: Honey Sun Dried. 
 Roast Profile: Dark Roast 
 Tasting notes: Chocolate, Toffee.

Name: Cyanotype Workshop by Kapila Nahender
Desc:
Discover the magic of cyanotype printing in this hands-on workshop by Kapila. Participants will work with a light-sensitive solution applied to watercolor paper in a darkened room, layer leaves, flowers, and natural textures, and expose their compositions to sunlight. Over time, the exposed areas transform into rich green-blue tones, which are then washed in cold water to reveal a permanent Prussian blue print. Celebrated for its accessibility and organic nature, cyanotype offers a slow, tactile, and deeply creative way to make art—no prior experience needed.

Name: Hario Cafe Press Slim - French press brewer
Tasting_Notes: coffee on your palate, you've come to the right equipment page
Desc:
If you love your coffee with a nice bold body, then French press brewing is for you. This method of brewing is by immersion - where the coffee grounds are kept immersed in hot water for a few minutes (depending on how strong or not you like your coffee). This method of brewing also draws out the coffee bean oils, giving the final brew a very unique flavour and strength. If you love the lingering taste of coffee on your palate, you've come to the right equipment page.  
 For this brewing equipment, you will require a coarser grind of coffee. Place the coffee powder in the Hario Cafe Press and pour hot water upto the level indicated. Place the plunger on the surface of the brew and let the coffee brew for 1-4 minutes (depending on your desired flavour and boldness). Simply plunge at the end of the brew and pour coffee into your cup.  
 Made in Japan by Hario. Good for 1-2 cups.

Name: Hario coffee server (carafe) - glass
Desc:
This coffee server made of heat-resistant glass is the perfect companion for your pour-over dripper. It collects between 1-3 cups of filtered coffee from our pour-over is is easy to handle and serve. If you either brew more than one cup of coffee at a time or your are brewing pour-over coffee to share with someone else, this piece of equipment is perfect for you.  
 This coffee server is designed to keep your brewed coffee away from the surface (table) as much as is possible (because of a partially elevated glass bottom) so that your coffee stays hot longer.  
 Made in Japan by Hario 
 Collects upto 450 ml of coffee, perfect for home use.

Name: Hario v60 coffee dripper - size 02
Desc:
An incredible easy, yet delicious method of brewing coffee. This v60 pour-over brewer sits on top of your coffee cup. Place your filter paper (not included with this product) in this v60 dripper, add your choice of coffee grounds, and just pour hot water in a steady, circular stream. in a few minutes, your coffee is done! Simple, but oh so flavourful. We love re-using filter papers too, check out our video to figure out how.  
 This v60 coffee dripper is made of food-grade plastic, heat resistant, and super easy to travel with too. Made in Japan by Hario, a legendary name in single-serve home brewing.  
 You could choose to add a glass server (carafe) to your shopping cart if you think you are going to be brewing more than a cup at a time. Unless you don't like sharing :)

Name: Ol' Smoky - Cold Smoked coffee!
Tasting_Notes: Sweet smoke
Desc:
The world's first cold-smoked coffee is now in its fourth year! For those who love a mellow, sweet-smoky lining to their favourite drink, this Maverick creation is for them. Freshly pulped arabica green beans are cold-smoked for 13-14 hours in a smokehouse to create this unusual, exquisite coffee. You will best enjoy this black or slow cold-brewed with a touch of milk. Pour-over brewing will help retain most of the fruity-smokiness.  
 Ol' Smoky by Maverick & Farmer is a micro-lot coffee, we have a limited batch this year.   
 Watch a video that explains how we make this beautiful coffee  
     
 Bean: Arabica 
 Process: Washed, cold-smoked 
 Roast Profile: medium-light 
 Tasting notes: Sweet smoke, roasted spice.

Name: Orange You Curious?
Tasting_Notes: Citrus, cherry wine
Desc:
Orange You Curious? is an orange juice fermented coffee. Our freshly pulped arabica beans go through a unique barrel fermentation process with orange juice (from our orange trees on the coffee farm) for 24 hours. The natural yeasts present on the orange skins, as well as the coffee skins, work on the fruit sugars and produce some truly unique flavours and fragrances.  
 This coffee was first created in 2020 as a tiny microlot, and it is today one of our fastest-selling favourites! 
 Enjoy this coffee black or with a tiny amount of milk. Cold-brewing Orange You Curious is awesome too! 
 Orange You Curious? from the Maverick & Farmer is a micro-lot coffee; we have a limited batch this year. 
 
 
 Bean: Arabica 
 Process: Washed, primary, and secondary fermented 
 Roast Profile: medium-light 
 Tasting notes: Citrus, cherry wine.

Say Hello To Mellow is a mild roast / light roast coffee that's truly bright and beautiful, and works perfectly as a black coffee or a light cappuccino/latte. This single estate arabica is a fully washed coffee, enabling a completely clean cup that   allows   all the geo-characteristics of the beans to shine through. Like all arabicas, this coffee has a nice, refreshing mouthfeel to it.   
  Say Hello To Mellow has  notes of Banana and Berries.  
 Best way to brew this? Pour-over or any other method where contact time with water isn't too much. But if you want to increase boldness in your brew, a French Press or even a simply Channi (steel strainer) works fabulously. Say Hello to your mornings that just got better! 
 Bean: Arabica 
 Roast profile: Mild Roast 
 Tasting notes: Notes of Banana and Berry

Desc:

Name: South Indian Brass Filter
Desc:
Made of pure brass, this is a traditional brewing equipment for home use, or makes for a perfect gift. The South Indian brass filter extracts a strong brew, giving the coffee a heavy-body, packed with flavour and aroma. 
 The lid at the top of the filter has a little handle made of wood, and this gives the filter an elegant look, as well as makes it convenient to open and shut the lid when the entire apparatus is hot.  
 Coffee powder is put into the upper chamber and hot water is added. This is placed over the lower chamber and the coffee is allowed to drip slowly. The resultant brew is thick and concentrated, and full of flavour. Add this to hot milk or hot water.

Name: Sunkissed
Tasting_Notes: Fruity, citrus, buttercup
Desc:
Sunkissed is our honey sun-dried coffee. While naturally processing the coffee, we leave a lot of the fruity pulp on the bean and allow it to mellow out in filtered sunshine for a week or so. The fruitiness from the pulp gets into the bean and creates a fruity, citrussy cup. Sunkissed is an award-winning specialty Robusta. 
 Bean: Robusta 
 Process: Honey Sun-dried 
 Roast Profile: Dark, just past the first crack. 
 Tasting notes: Fruity, citrus, buttercup.

Name: The Coffee and Cheese pairing workshop with Käse
Desc:
While pairing cheese and coffee may not be commonplace, it isn’t very difficult to think of them together! Think of a ricotta bar with coffee or a more indulgent Basque cheesecake. How can     we forget the freshly brewed filter coffee decoction with frothy milk or cappuccino,     macchiatos     or a     cortado    ! Milk with its proteins and fats play an important role in making the coffee enjoyable but cheese with its sensory qualities and textures adds a di    fferent dimension.   
   Bhavi Patel A dairy technologist & brand building specialist with a keen interest in foodomics & neurogastronomy, Bhavi loves telling stories, experimenting with ingredients & pairings, and nerding out over the science behind food.   
   Namrata Sundaresan Namrata, is the Co-founder of Käse. Armed with a degree in business management and 15 years in international trade & Investment consulting it was the love of food that got her Introduced to cheesemaking! Her extensive travels introduced her to excellent cheeses across the world.

Name: The Maverick Coffee Experience: Farm to Cup
Tasting_Notes: body, and aroma like a true coffee taster. 2
Desc:
The Maverick Coffee Experience: Farm to Cup   
 An immersive, guided journey into the world of specialty coffee- crafted for both curious beginners and coffee lovers alike by Faiyaz Tharakar. At Maverick & Farmer, we take you beyond just drinking coffee and into truly experiencing it- understanding its origin, process, flavour, and craft. 
 Over the course of this session, you’ll explore a curated selection of coffees through multiple formats, designed to help you taste, compare, and engage with coffee in a more meaningful way. 
   What to Expect   
  1. Coffee Cupping (30 mins)  Begin with a classic cupping session where you’ll taste 3-4 distinct coffees side by side- featuring profiles like Washed, Monsoon Malabar, and Modur Naturals. Learn to identify flavour notes, body, and aroma like a true coffee taster. 
  2. Brew Comparison (20 mins)  Experience how brewing changes everything. Taste the same coffee prepared using two different methods and understand how technique impacts flavour, texture, and balance. 
  3. Pairing Experience (15 mins)  Discover the art of pairing coffee with complementary desserts- bringing out hidden notes and enhancing the overall tasting experience. 
  4. Interactive Segment (10 mins)  Put your senses to the test with fun activities like blind tasting and aroma identification—making the session engaging and memorable. 
  5. Closing & Retail Experience (5 mins)  Wrap up the session with an opportunity to take home your favourite coffees. Enjoy a Rs 250 voucher towards retail purchases of the beans you’ve just explored. 
  When? At 4:30 PM, on 4th April, 2026  
 
 Where? Kothanur, Maverick, and Farmer Outlet.  
 
  Limited spots, so book your seats now!

Name: The work-from-home kit - Discounted price!
Desc:
A simple, easy to use work-from-home coffee kit to make endless cups of coffee through the day! This set comes with a stylish and futuristic TimeMore French Press that comes with a superior steel superfine filter and an additional filter for pouring, an artisanal handmade Maverick & Farmer ceramic cup (find out  more ) and a 250 gm pack of  Parama  by Maverick & Farmer.  
 The French Press makes a rich brew that's full of body and flavour. As you gain experience with this method of brewing you will very soon be able to vary brewing times and play with coffee dosage to create your own brewing recipes that work best for you.  
 If you like your coffee with a milk, then you can use this same kit to make a home-style 'cappuccino' or a 'latte'. Watch these  videos  to find out how! 
 This kit which costs Rs. 2,539 with shipping is available as a set at Rs. 2,300 with FREE SHIPPING!

Granola that's loaded with almonds. And almond butter. And peanut butter. And dates. And honey. And cold pressed coconut oil. What more can a cup of coffee ask for as the perfect breakfast date. Munch on this pack of natural awesomeness that's full of the right fats, fibre and energy. Wash it down with your cup of coffee and you're set for the day! Name: Two Beans In A Pod
Tasting_Notes: Chocolate (obviously!), Ripe Plum
Desc:
Cocoa beans, like coffee beans, go through a similar fermentation process once harvested and scooped out of the pod. Fermentation gives the beans a complexity in flavour apart from being necessary to prepare the beans for the next step - roasting..  
 With Two Beans In A Pod, we've developed a unique method of fermenting freshly harvested beans of both cocoa and coffee, allowing a whole new world of microbes and sugar seeking bio-reactions to take over the process and in turn creating some really ingenious and beautiful flavours.  
 Two Beans In A Pod is part of our 6 Maverick coffees for 21/22. 
  
 Bean: Single estate Arabica coffee and Malnad Cocoa 
 Process: Washed, primary and secondary fermented 
 Roast Profile: medium 
 Tasting notes: Chocolate (obviously!), Ripe Plum

Name: What The Ale!?
Tasting_Notes: The acidity is a most pleasing lemony zest that sets off the stout-like notes so perfectly.
Desc:
Add yeast to malted grain and water and what do you get... beer? Not if you also add a micro lot of some freshly harvested arabica coffee beans to the mix.  
 What the Ale!? is our beer-fermented coffee. Coffee notes in ale as an idea is as old as the hills, especially in a kind of beer called Stout. For the first time we're using the beer fermentation process to create an experimental coffee. The process is super-complicated, but what it means for you as a coffee drinker is this -  
 A medium roast coffee that is sweet, full bodied and ever-so slightly funky. The acidity is a most pleasing lemony zest that sets off the stout-like notes so perfectly. This is deliciousness. Take our word for it.  
  
 Bean: Arabica 
 Process: Washed, primary and secondary fermented 
 Roast Profile: medium 
 Tasting notes: Stout. Lemon zest.

Name: Exuberance | 90% Coffee, 10% Chicory | Chicory Filter Coffee

Desc:
MokkaFarms South Indian Filter Coffee Powder - Exuberance variant - is made with the perfect blend of 90% coffee mix and 10% chicory to create a rich and robust flavor. This traditional South Indian style coffee is known for its unique brewing process and distinct taste. The coffee mix used in this powder is carefully selected to ensure a high-quality and aromatic experience. It is sourced from one of the finest coffee beans, which are roasted to perfection to bring out their natural flavors. The addition of chicory adds a deep and earthy flavor that complements the coffee and enhances its overall taste. Our South Indian filter coffee powder is ideal for those who appreciate a strong and flavorful cup of coffee. It is specifically designed to be used with the traditional filter coffee method, which allows the flavors to fully develop and provides a smooth and satisfying texture. To prepare the perfect cup of South Indian filter coffee, simply add the desired amount of coffee powder to a coffee filter and pour hot water over it. Allow the coffee to drip slowly and collect in a separate vessel or cup. Finally, add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the rich and aromatic flavors of this authentic South Indian coffee. Experience the taste of South India with our premium quality filter coffee powder, carefully crafted to deliver a truly special coffee drinking experience.  
  Proudly Made in India!

Desc: Our search for the immaculate espresso began when we were embraced by the warm welcome of Ramdev and his parents Shantha and Nagesh as we drove through the gates of Bettadamalali Estate in early 2023. A pristine farm nestled in the Baba Budan Giri hills of Chikmagalur, this place is more than a commercial operation – it is a garden of nature’s best delights. Tasting_Notes: Within each cherry on the coffee tree, two beans are grown side by side, resulting in the flat face of most beans.Peaberries, however, occur when only one of the two seeds is fertilized, growing on its own without anything to flatten it.
Desc:
Most coffee beans are born twins.  Within each cherry on the coffee tree, two beans are grown side by side, resulting in the flat face of most beans.Peaberries, however, occur when only one of the two seeds is fertilized, growing on its own without anything to flatten it.  
 As a result of heir independence, peaberry observes all the goodness.  Many coffee connoisseurs have suggested that each peaberry in infused with all the assets normally reserved for two beans.  These beans are most certainly unique and livelier cup with sweeter and bright taste, so giving special liquoring .

Name: ONCE Upon a FARM Mylemoney Single Origin Coffee
Tasting_Notes: toasted nuts & cinnamon
Desc:
Once upon a Farm Mylemoney Estate Single Origin Coffee 
 ORIGIN: MYLEMONEY, CHIKMAGALUR ALTITUDE: 1220 M Above MSL Tasting Notes: Toasted Nuts, Cinnamon (Expect a bright cup with fair and delicate mouthfeel, along with hints of toasted nuts & cinnamon.) 
 contains 100% coffee 0% Chicory  
 Panduranga Plantation, nestled in the scenic beauty of Mylemoney, the magnanimous location within the Mullayanagiri mountain range, boasts lush green forests and serves as a habitat for rich wildlife. It’s history dates back to the early 19th century when the legendary British planter, Thomas Cannon, discovered this ideal location to grow Coffee. Cannon’s vision led to the establishment of one of the finest coffee estates in the region. By the 1860s, the reputation of Mylemoney’s coffee, branded as Cannon’s Coffee, had spread even to the London market, attesting to its exceptional quality. This was the first place where coffee was cultivated commercially in India. Also Mylemoney is renowned for growing one of the earliest varieties of Arabica coffee, known as the Kent, celebrated for it’s exquisite cupping quality and the magical flavors it imparts. Panduranga plantations takes pride in being part of this timeless heritage, cherishing its legacy and contributing to the continued excellence of the region’s coffee industry

Tasting_Notes: ripe fruit, caramel-like sweetness, and a round, creamy body, all while maintaining a gentle acidity
Desc: Honey sun-dried coffee is a beautifully balanced processing style where the coffee cherries are de-pulped but dried with part of the sticky, sweet mucilage still clinging to the beans. As they dry slowly under the sun, this natural sweetness infuses into the seeds, creating a cup that is smooth, syrupy, and vibrant. Expect flavours of ripe fruit, caramel-like sweetness, and a round, creamy body, all while maintaining a gentle acidity. This method highlights both the terroir and the careful craftsmanship of the producer making honey sun-dried coffees a favourite in the speciality world. Desc: The Basankhan Estate is a family-owned farm located in Chikmagalur, Karnataka with a rich history spanning over 100 years. It was originally founded by their great grandfather, Mr. Gulamenabi, and subsequently managed by G. Abdul Wajid & Sons. Now in its fourth generation, the estate continues to flourish.After picking cherries from the trees, the farm initiates immediate processing. Unwanted cherries are removed, and the coffee is meticulously cleaned with water. A pulping machine is then used to remove the outer layer of the cherries, after which the washed coffee is soaked in water for 12 hours before being transferred to the drying yard.The focus of the Basankhan Estate is to consistently produce the finest beans from their crop. They prioritise thorough washing by performing the process twice. The drying methods employed include mat drying, shade drying, regular drying, and more. During the drying process, careful attention is paid to rotation, ensuring equal drying by turning the coffee every hour. Flavour – Caramel, Citrus, Gooseberry Roast Level – Medium Acidity Level – Medium Bitterness Level – Low Body – Medium Altitude – 1450 MASL Processing – Washed Varietal – SLN 795 Location -Chikmagalur

Desc: Monsoon Malabar is one of India’s most legendary coffee styles born along the Malabar Coast, shaped by nature, and cherished for its unmistakable flavour. Originally discovered when wooden-hulled ships carried Indian coffee to Europe, the beans would swell, mellow, and transform during the long sea voyages through the monsoon winds. Today, this naturally occurring phenomenon is carefully recreated in controlled warehouses along the coast. Exposed to moist monsoon winds for several weeks, the beans undergo a slow, deliberate transformation: their colour turns pale gold, their size nearly doubles, and their acidity softens beautifully. The result is a bold, smooth, and earthy cup with notes of spice, wood, cocoa, and a gentle sweetness, finishing with a low-acid, rounded body that makes it perfect for espresso and milk-based drinks. At Roastery Coffee House, our Monsoon Malabar celebrates India’s heritage an ode to tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique terroir of the Western Ghats. Rich, comforting, and unmistakably Indian. Name: Iceberg Naturals
Tasting_Notes: of hawflakes (nostalgic Chinese confection), plum blossom, persimmon, and mango
Desc:
Iceberg, Our final limited release of the year, crafted to mark the close of 2025 with something truly special. This exceptional coffee embodies a meticulous, hands-on approach to quality that elevates it beyond the ordinary.  
 Starting its journey at  Riverdale Estate , Yercaud in Tamil Nadu, each cherry is carefully hand-picked where slower maturation enhances sugar content and mucilage density, key aspects of  natural process coffee . The processor ensure only the ripest cherries move forward, using a Brix meter to measure sugar levels precisely. 
 Once harvested, the cherries undergo a thorough triple wash using natural spring water from its own estate to remove impurities, followed by a floating process to eliminate underdeveloped beans. The highest-density cherries are fermented with the addition of rose petals, enhancing the development of flavonoids and bringing out cleaner, brighter fruit notes along with a unique floral character. 
 After fermentation, the cherries are slow-dried on raised beds for up to 30 days, promoting even drying and improved air circulation. This careful process ensures a vibrant, clean cup. The coffee is hulled in our dry mill, where our quality control team meticulously hand-picks any defective beans. To maintain maximum freshness, all our  natural process coffees  are vacuum-sealed to preserve moisture levels between 11–13%. 
 Roasted to perfection by our head roaster, Baninder Kochar,  Iceberg coffee  is profiled for a clean, balanced cup that highlights delicate exotic florals, complemented by Savorworks’ signature long, lingering aftertaste. Expect bright, clean flavors with tasting notes of hawflakes (nostalgic Chinese confection), plum blossom, persimmon, and mango. 
   Facts:   Estate: Riverdale Estate Process: Iceberg Naturals Varietal: SLN9 &  5B Altitude: 1450 MASL      
   Feels:    Tasting Notes: Haw Flakes, Plum Blossom, Persimmon, Mango Acidity: Malic Body: Medium Aftertaste: Long

Name: Cascara
Desc:
Cascara stands as a testament to the principles of the circular economy movement, transforming coffee fruit peels, typically discarded, into a valuable product. This innovative approach involves processing the overlooked byproduct into a brew reminiscent of fruity loose leaf tea or incorporating it into artisanal baking. 
 The introduction of single origin cascara serves a dual purpose. Primarily, it aims to create a continuous cycle of value for our producer partners at the source. Secondly, it seeks to highlight the rich sensory diversity of microlot Cascara, an often overlooked byproduct of the coffee industry. This mirrors the existing appreciation for the varied profiles found in coffee itself, presenting a new dimension to the overall coffee experience.

Name: Cross Roast Series - Drop 1
Desc:
Cross Roast Series — Siolim × One Half  
 The Cross Roast Series is a collaborative roasting project between  Siolim Specialty Coffee Roasters (India)  and  One Half Roastery (Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia).  
 For this release, each roastery roasted a coffee sourced by the other, exchanging not just green coffee, but also roasting philosophies. 
 Siolim selected one of its coffees from the Inner Pearl Series, which was roasted by  Keith Koay , four-time Malaysian Barista Champion and founder of  One Half Roastery , an award-winning roastery based in Kuala Lumpur. 
 In return, Siolim roasted one of One Half’s sourced coffees, a  Panama Geisha  from the  Cordillera region , processed as washed, a competition-level lot known for its elegance and complexity. 
 Both coffees are competition lots, showcasing how different roasting perspectives can interpret exceptional coffees. 
 The set includes two 100g coffees, presented together to allow brewers to experience this cross-roasting experiment side by side. 
 To preserve peak flavour, the coffee roasted by Keith at One Half was frozen just before its optimal resting window, ensuring the cup profile remains as expressive as intended when brewed. 
 The Cross Roast Series celebrates collaboration, craft, and the idea that roasting is interpretation even when the coffees themselves are extraordinary.

Name: Excelsa
Tasting_Notes: sweet cherry and lychee
Desc:
Excelsa — Mooleh Manay Estate, Coorg  
  Origin  
 Grown amidst the serene backwaters of the Harangi Reservoir in Coorg, Mooleh Manay Estate is a fourth- generation farm now led by Komal and Akshay Dashrath. With 75 acres of clay-loamy soil and 65 inches of annual rainfall, their approach blends data-driven precision with a deep respect for nature. Every cherry is selectively hand-picked, fermented with intent, and dried with patience each step reflecting the care and curiosity that define their craft. 
  About the Producer  
 The estate works closely with the South India Coffee Company (SICC)  a green coffee collective committed to transparency, traceability, and research. Through SICC Labs, the company explores low- intervention species and climate-resilient coffee farming, charting a sustainable future for Indian coffee. 
  Why Excelsa  
 While most of the world’s attention rests on Arabica and Robusta, Excelsa remains a quiet outlier. A rare coffee species that bridges intensity and intrigue. Once grown along farm borders in India, Excelsa trees tower high and challenge harvesters with their wild nature. Yet within their small, round beans lies an extraordinary spectrum of flavor — bright, juicy, and surprisingly complex. 
 The Mooleh Manay Excelsa lot we roast has been DNA-verified by the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and naturally carries a low caffeine content (0.9–0.98%) without compromising on depth. Even in milk-based brews, it retains its vivid fruit character, a rarity in the world of coffee. 
  Processing  
 This lot underwent an 84-hour yeast-inoculated natural fermentation, sealed in oxygen-restricted tanks to create a carbonic maceration environment. 
 - Harvesting: Only fully ripe cherries - hand-picked one by one. 
 - Sorting: Water flotation ensures uniform density and ripeness. 
 - Fermentation: Controlled yeast fermentation deepens sweetness and clarity. 
 - Drying: Slow, steady drying on raised beds within polyhouses. 
 - Resting: After reaching 11–12% moisture, the coffee rests for two months to allow its flavors to mature naturally. 
  Cup Profile  
 A cup that bursts with layered berry complexity, rounded by notes of sweet cherry and lychee. Low in caffeine, yet high in character - Excelsa is a reminder that beauty often thrives in the margins. 
  At Siolim  
 We roast this coffee to celebrate its unconventional story, a species often overlooked, rediscovered with care. Excelsa challenges our understanding of what Indian coffee can be: wild, bold, and beautifully untamed.
