Throughout the drying process, the temperature and humidity were carefully monitored to maintain a controlled environment.

Name: Solo Dripper — Mazelab
Desc:
Designed by Jackie Tran (WBrC 2024 Finalist), the Solo Dripper is a compact pour-over brewer built for clarity, balance, and portability. Made from durable polypropylene, it’s lightweight enough to travel yet precise enough for competition-level brews.  
  The Solo’s 40° angled walls, curved base, and central flow channel are engineered for clean, consistent extraction. Water moves smoothly through the coffee bed for faster flow, bright flavors, and well-rounded cups without over-extraction.  
  Every detail — from geometry to flow rate — is intentional. Even saturation, minimal channeling, and repeatable results make it a brewer you can rely on anywhere — at home, in the café, or on the road.  
        Why it stands out  
 
 
  Bright, clean cups   — faster flow highlights clarity and vibrancy.      
 
 
  Balanced extraction   — 40° angle + curved base ensures even saturation.      
 
 
  Built for consistency   — easy to control taste through grind and pour.      
 
 
  Durable & portable   — compact, travel-ready polypropylene design.      
 
 
  Designed for brewers   — created by a World Brewers Cup finalist.      
 
 
     Details  
 
 
  Capacity: 1–2 cups      
 
 
  Material: Polypropylene (PP)      
 
 
  Filter: Cake-shaped filter paper      
 
 
  Angle: 40°      
 
 
  Designed in Prague

Name: Stillness
Tasting_Notes: white flowers, wild berries, and mulberry—a quiet moment in every sip
Desc: Stillness is a refined microlot from Ratnagiri Estate, crafted with care by Ashok Patre at 1400 MASL. A delicate SL9 / Caversham varietal, it offers a serene cup with notes of white flowers, wild berries, and mulberry—a quiet moment in every sip.

Name: Tender
Tasting_Notes: rose, cardamom, and saffron
Desc: Crafted by Ashok Patre at Ratnagiri Estate, Tender is a delicate, aromatic coffee with notes of rose, cardamom, and saffron. Its anaerobic natural process draws out warmth and nuance, inviting quiet reflection. A celebration of openness, softness, and emotional clarity.

Name: Torrent
Tasting_Notes: Tasting of strawberry jam, grapes, and mixed fruits, it captures the rush of intense feeling — wild, bright, and overflowing with energy.
Desc: Produced by Ashok Patre at Ratnagiri Estate, Torrent is an expressive, fruit-saturated coffee processed using hydro-honey and dark room fermentation. Tasting of strawberry jam, grapes, and mixed fruits, it captures the rush of intense feeling — wild, bright, and overflowing with energy.

Name: Unseen
Tasting_Notes: raisins, fig, and molasses—a rich journey into the unexpected
Desc: Unseen is a distinctive microlot from Ratnagiri Estate, grown by Ashok Patre at 1400 MASL. A Hemavati / SL9 varietal, it reveals layered sweetness with notes of raisins, fig, and molasses—a rich journey into the unexpected.

Name: Vasco Da Gama Blend
Tasting_Notes: Layers of dark chocolate provide depth, while vibrant berry notes and a crisp hint of apple add brightness and balance.
Desc:
Vasco da Gama Blend  – Designed to redefine your cold brew ritual, the Vasco da Gama Blend brings together bold richness and refreshing clarity. Layers of dark chocolate provide depth, while vibrant berry notes and a crisp hint of apple add brightness and balance. 
 Smooth and velvety, this blend is crafted to shine in cold brew, delivering a refined cup that feels both indulgent and refreshing. With every sip, Vasco da Gama captures the spirit of adventure—perfect for those seeking sophistication in their everyday coffee.

Name: Whiskey Barrel Aged
Tasting_Notes: For this unique whiskey barrel-aged process, we begin by soaking barrels in premium single malt whiskey for 30 days, allowing the wood to absorb the rich, deep flavors.
Desc: For this unique whiskey barrel-aged process, we begin by soaking barrels in premium single malt whiskey for 30 days, allowing the wood to absorb the rich, deep flavors. Once seasoned, the barrels are emptied and filled with Single Origin, Naturally processed coffee beans from Ratnagiri Estate. Over the next 45 days, the beans absorb the whiskey essence, resulting in a rich coffee with malty notes

Desc: Whisper is a rich microlot from Ratnagiri Estate, nurtured by Ashok Patre at 1400 MASL. This Catuai varietal unfolds with deep notes of plum, dark cherries, and dark chocolate—a quiet indulgence that lingers.

Name: Yemen
Tasting_Notes: Hand-picked and naturally sun-dried in arid mountain air, the Jaddi varietal reveals a floral-spiced sweetness reminiscent of hibiscus and rose, balanced by cola and vanilla undertones.
Desc: In the ancient terraces of Haraaz, Yemen  where coffee first journeyed to the world  this lot embodies centuries of craft and culture. Hand-picked and naturally sun-dried in arid mountain air, the Jaddi varietal reveals a floral-spiced sweetness reminiscent of hibiscus and rose, balanced by cola and vanilla undertones. A rare expression of Yemen’s rugged beauty, reborn through the lens of modern precision.

Name: Project Pearl, Ratnagiri Estate, Karnataka (SCA 86+): Culture naturals+ Anaerobic Naturals: Filter Roast (Light)
Tasting_Notes: Filter Blend from Ratnagiri Estate, Karnataka Filter Roast (Light) - (250g) Process : Culture Naturals+ Anaerobic Naturals Agtron Meter : 89 Altitude : 1356 MASL Varietal : Catuai + Hemavathi Cupper's Notes: Marigold, dragon fruit, peach tea.
Desc:
Filter Blend from Ratnagiri Estate, Karnataka 
  Filter Roast (Light) - (250g)  
  Process : Culture Naturals+ Anaerobic Naturals 
  Agtron Meter : 89 
  Altitude : 1356 MASL 
  Varietal : Catuai + Hemavathi 
 Cupper's Notes: Marigold, dragon fruit, peach tea. 
 Flavour Meter 
 
   
 
 Best Brewed With 
  FILTER ROAST  
   
  Please note that the best brewed with list is not comprehensive and does not dictate that the coffees cannot be brewed with any other methods. These are the the methods we think will extract the best possible cup. However, this coffee can be ground and enjoyed with any brew method that you desire.   
  Filter Roast:  Manual brewing methods fall under the artisanal brewing style of coffee. Roasting a coffee is also an art, we have developed this filter roast to maintain the quality while brewing over Pour over, Kalita, V60, Origami, April, Chemex. Culture naturals+ Anaerobic Naturals : - RT- YC -1/1: This is a 72-hour CULTURE PROCESS natural processed coffee. It is from the CATUAI varietal grown on our farm at 4400 feet from the block called GODOWN Patte. The Brix of the coffee cherries was 25.4 when harvested and they were put in the Bio fermenters after floater removal. A particular strain of yeast and lactic acid bacteria was added to the coffee in the fermenters and allowed to ferment for 72 hours in a carbon dioxide rich environment. After removing the coffee, they were directly put on raised beds for slow drying. The coffee was then dried slowly with constant stirring over the next 29 days. 
   LAB PROCESS 07:  This is a 60-hour anaerobic fermentation natural processed coffee. It is from the HEMAVTHI varietal grown on our farm at 4450 feet from the block called LINE Patte. The Brix of the coffee cherries was 23.9 when harvested and they were put in the Bio fermenters after floater removal and allowed to ferment for 60 hours in a Nitrogen rich environment with lab grown microbes isolated from the farm. After removing the coffee from the fermenters, it was directly put on raised beds for slow drying. The coffee was then dried slowly with constant stirring over the next 28 days.        
 About Project Pearl 
 
     
 
 In the Indian Specialty Coffee Industry, the name Ratnagiri Estate evinces a recognition of steadily elevating excellence, innovation, and a devotion to sustainability. The name Ratnagiri itself, translates to pearl mountain. 
  Over the years, Ratnagiri Estate's legacy in the Indian specialty coffee industry has steadily elevated as the flagbearers of specialty coffee growing, processing, and Indian specialty coffee representation overseas. 
  Today we’re honoured to be able to tell their story in the fullness of their legacy, with Project Pearl — a microlot program featuring 8 microlots from Ratnagiri Estate, exclusive only to Subko, that showcase the high-scoring, experimentally processed coffees that are a testament to their humble beginnings.

  About the Process  
  Gurram Hand Washed:   The process, known as "Gurram Hand Washed," involves a small tribal community using their bare hands to pulp coffee fruits after fermentation. They then wash or demucilage the coffee with their hands.  
  Flavor Meter  
   
 
 Cupper's Notes  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This coffee lot, roasted for an espresso brew or strong extraction, boasts a flavor profile reminiscent of sweet honey and walnuts, coupled with a heavy body. It features a prolonged, brown sugar-like finish and notes of caramel candy. The mellow, citric aftertaste is akin to that of a semi-ripe dragon fruit. 
 
 
 
 
 
  About Subko VLGE: Co-operative Agriculture  
 A sustainable, farm-to-table-to-farmer operation by Subko 
   Founded by Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters and Craft Bakehouse, the Subko Co-op initiative finds its roots in the village of K. Thadiputtu in Andhra Pradesh. Concentrating its efforts on the holistic advancement of the 'Subko Village,' Subko Co-op has adopted a cluster comprising six tribal farmers from K. Thadiputtu village in Paderu, Andhra Pradesh. With a dedication to bringing these individuals to the forefront of the third wave of coffee, Subko Co-op seeks to not only empower these farmers but to also nurture growth within their entire community.   
   This initiative is focused on tribal farmers who cultivate coffee on government-allotted lands. With an attention on driving direct trade, sustainability, and hyper-traceability, the initiative embodies a commitment to elevating the agricultural landscape in the world of coffee. This endeavor aims to adopt more such clusters in the future. Furthermore, Subko Co-op envisions the establishment of training centers, designed to empower and educate both farmers and their families, paving the way for them to become coffee professionals and authentic representatives of their cultural legacy and heritage. Subko Co-op’s objective is to emerge as a transformative force, reshaping the narrative of coffee cultivation by amalgamating sustainable practices, cultural preservation, and community empowerment, and to narrate origin stories and recognise every stakeholder who puts their heart in coffee cultivation.

Name: Project Seven Sisters, Dima Hasao, Assam: Traditional Naturals, Omniroast (Medium)
Tasting_Notes: This method produces coffees with a heavier body, greater sweetness, and pronounced fruity or wine-like character.
Desc:
Single Origin Arabica Microlot from Dima Hasao, Assam  
  Medium Roast (250g)  
  Process : Traditional Naturals  
  Varietal:  Caturra, Bourbon, Typica 
  Agtron Meter:  65 
  Roast:  Omniroast 
  Cupper's Notes:    Stone Fruit, Red Cherry, Caramel  
 
     
 
 
 
   
 
   
  OMNIROAST   Please note that the best brewed with list is not comprehensive and does not dictate that the coffees cannot be brewed with any other methods. These are the the methods we think will extract the best possible cup. However, this coffee can be ground and enjoyed with any brew method that you desire.    
 
   About the Process 
 
   Traditional Naturals:   
 In this traditional natural process, ripe coffee cherries are harvested and dried whole, with the skin and pulp left intact. As they dry, sugars and fruit compounds slowly ferment and infuse into the bean. The cherries are spread across patios or raised beds and turned regularly to prevent defects, until they reach a stable moisture level for hulling. This method produces coffees with a heavier body, greater sweetness, and pronounced fruity or wine-like character. 
  About the Roast  
 
   Medium Roast  :  At Subko, a Medium roast is one that is obtained by dropping the coffee lot at 201°-204°C. These roasts are generally of a sensory profile that is very smooth, caramel and complex tropical fruits. In terms of the Agtron scale, Subko's definition of medium lies between the points 60 to 74, with 74 being the lightest version of a medium roast, and 60 being the darkest version of the roast.

Desc:

Name: The Saigon Blend
Tasting_Notes: Despite its dark
Desc:
The Saigon Blend 
  It's a Good Morning, Vietnam  
 Inspired by the rich culture, traditions, and flavours of Vietnam, The Saigon Blend is a tribute to the vibrant coffee heritage of this Southeast Asian gem. Crafted from premium Indian Arabica beans, this dark roast is meticulously balanced to offer a harmonious experience of bitterness, sweetness, and acidity. 
  Flavour Profile:  
 
 
 Toasted Nuts:  Warm, inviting, and reminiscent of traditional Vietnamese coffee. 
 
 Cacao:  A deep, rich chocolatey undertone that adds a velvety smoothness to every sip. 
 
  Roast Level:  Dark 
  Perfect For:  Iced manual brew, Vietnamese-style coffee, a hot cappuccino, or an iced black coffee 
  Tasting Notes:  
 
 Despite its dark roast, the flavours remain well-balanced, never overpowering, ensuring an enjoyable cup every time. 
 The nuanced bitterness is complemented by a subtle sweetness, making it versatile for various brewing methods. 
 The complex acidity rounds out the flavour, providing a full-bodied experience that lingers pleasantly on the palate. 
 
 Whether you're craving the boldness of a hot cappuccino or the refreshing chill of an iced brew, The Saigon Blend offers a taste of Vietnam in every cup. Embrace the morning with the rich, satisfying flavours of The Saigon Blend—because every day should start with a touch of Vietnam.

Name: Watermelon ferment - Perfect for Espresso & Cold Brew
Tasting_Notes: *No added sugar, honey, fruit, flavour, chicory, or preservatives.
Desc:
Watermelon Fermented   
  Inspired by innovative fermentation techniques , our Watermelon Fermented Coffee is crafted at the Baarbara Estate using only fresh watermelon pulp to highlight the fruit’s bright, juicy character. This medium-roast, 100% Arabica coffee delivers an exhilarating cup that’s as refreshing as it is complex. 
 Flavour Profile 
 
 
 Chocolate Truffles  → Deep, rich cocoa sweetness 
 
 Almonds & Cashews  → Warm, roasted-nut undertones 
 
 Dry Fruits  → Subtle texture of raisin and fig 
 
 Mellow Sweetness  → Silk-like finish that rounds out the cup 
 
  Origin & Process  
 
 
 Location:  Bababudangiri, Chikmagalur 
 
 Process:  Watermelon Fermented (coffee cherries co-fermented with ripe watermelon pulp) 
 
 Altitude:  3,850–5,350 ft 
 
  Roast & Brew  
 
 
 Roast Level:  Medium + roast 
 
 Perfect For:  Espresso, Cold Brew, French Press or Moka Pot  
 
  Allow your beans to  degas for 8–10 days  after roasting to develop and settle the nuanced chocolate-nut flavours. Over time, the cup will reveal layers of truffle-like richness, roasted-nut warmth and a gentle, lingering sweetness. 
   
  
  *No added sugar, honey, fruit, flavour, chicory, or preservatives.  
     Tulum® – Specialty Coffee Roasters

Name: Black Honey (Medium - Dark)
Tasting_Notes: The beans come covered in pulp, which looks and taste like honey.
Desc:
This is a coffee for those who enjoy layers in their cup. Balanced fruit and nut flavors shine with both clarity and depth, creating a taste that is rich but never heavy.   
  Process  
   The skin of the coffee cherries are removed using a machine called ‘Pulper’. The beans come covered in pulp, which looks and taste like honey. The beans covered in this gooey pulp is sun-dried, producing a balanced fruit-and-nut cup in high clarity and body.

Name: Carbonic Maceration (Medium)
Desc:
This coffee is for those who want a dependable cup that feels effortless yet never boring. Easy to brew, it rewards you with smooth, layered flavors and a rounded finish that keeps you coming back every day.   
       Process   
  Liquid CO2 from thin, long gas cylinders vaporize into gas as they fill the fermentation chamber brimming with coffee cherries. This process causes a drop in temperature and death of microbes that can’t survive in an atmosphere of CO2, leaving the rest to feast on the rich natural sugars. Produces smooth, complex notes and a rounded finish .

Tasting_Notes: Produces nutty flavours in exceptional clarity and consistency.
Desc:
This coffee is for those who want strength in their cup. It’s bold, earthy, and packed with caffeine that keeps you awake and keeps you going. Perfect for making Vietnamese iced coffee at home, or whenever you need that extra push.  
       Process   
  The coffee cherries are put through the ‘Pulper’ and ‘Washer’, and the beans are washed clean of all the pulp. The naked bean is sun-dried, eschewing the fruit in its entirety. Produces nutty flavours in exceptional clarity and consistency.

Name: Yellow Honey (Medium - Dark)
Tasting_Notes: Rich nutty flavors form the base, with just a dash of fruit to keep it lively.
Desc:
This coffee is clean, bright, and easy to drink. Rich nutty flavors form the base, with just a dash of fruit to keep it lively. It’s a cup for people who like balance - simple, steady, and quietly satisfying.   
  Process  
 Like Black Honey, the skin is removed using the ‘Pulper’ machine. The pulp (‘Honey’) is hosed and rubbed down, using a machine called ‘Washer’. The beans covered in only a thin layer of pulp are put to sun-dry. Produces rich nutty flavours with a dash of fruitiness at high clarity.
